args.message: Revenue by region from customers in at least one email campaign: South 47,752.93, North 31,994.35, East 24,416.24, West 24,155.93. There are 77 such customers. Each customer's orders are counted once, no matter how many email campaigns they joined. The email campaigns are Spring, Autumn and Holiday Mailer. All order statuses are included.
